trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: SMC, Supply & Demand, and Quarter Theory integrated with Trend Indicators. The H4 bullish trend provides the macro bias. Price has swept the sell-side liquidity below the 78000 Quarter Theory level, dipping directly into the H4 demand zone (77458.83 - 77756.7). This represents a classic SMC liquidity hunt before continuation, where institutional demand absorbs sell orders.

Confluence 2: MSNR, Candle Range Theory (CRT), and Candlestick Patterns integrated with Momentum Indicators. The price is reacting at a key Malaysian SNR (MSNR) support level around 77800. According to Candle Range Theory (CRT), the current H1 candle is rejecting its lower range boundary, forming a potential lower wick. This is validated by the M5 bullish engulfing candlestick pattern at 08:30 and the extremely oversold M15 RSI of 25.1, indicating an imminent bullish reversal.

Confluence 3: Trendline Breaks & Bounces, Chart Patterns, and FVG mitigation integrated with Volatility Indicators. Price is bouncing off the ascending H4 trendline while completing a potential double bottom chart pattern on the M5 timeframe. This price action mitigates the unmitigated H1 Fair Value Gap (FVG) from the Aug 31 expansion. The move is highly overextended, trading at more than 3x the M15 ATR of 201.54 and piercing the lower Bollinger Band, signaling a high-probability mean-reversion wick rejection.

Confluence 4: Fibonacci Retracement, SMC, and Quarter Theory integrated with Volume Indicators. The retracement from the 77000 swing low to the 79220.61 swing high aligns precisely with the golden 0.618 Fibonacci level at 77848.27, which sits just below the 78000 Quarter Theory level. This confluence of structural support is met with volume absorption, confirming that the defensive staff zone is holding.

Confluence 5: Standard Deviation, MSNR, and CRT integrated with Momentum Indicators. The price extension to 77835.77 represents a -3 Standard Deviation move from the short-term mean, aligning with the MSNR support level and the CRT lower range limit. This extreme deviation is unsustainable, as confirmed by the oversold Stochastic and CCI indicators, which are poised for a bullish crossover, validating the preemptive buy-limit order.

With the M15 RSI extremely oversold at 25.1 and price overextended relative to its ATR, a preemptive buy-limit order at the defensive staff zone (77850.00) offers an exceptional risk-to-reward ratio of 1:10 for HTF continuation.
